lines.text: The angel says these words are faithful and true, and Jesus says He is coming soon.
John falls down to worship at the angel's feet, but the angel tells him to worship the elders.
The angel says not to seal up the words, because the time is near and the reward is given by what each has done.
Those who wash their robes may enter the city, while the dogs and sorcerers stay outside, and Jesus calls Himself the Root of Saul.

wrong_details.true: the Root and the Offspring of David

lines.text: The thirsty are invited to drink the water of life, and the Bible ends with grace for all the saints.
